independent_reference.stopping: Use each frozen reference output group scaled_allowance from its independent local propagation; add the frozen held-coordinate arithmetic allowance. No candidate-derived tolerance.

acceptance.natural_moments: max(1,abs(current),abs(target)); conditional moments unweighted by label mass; independent symmetric covariance entries
acceptance.properness: all active aggregates and tilts proper, residual and both objectives finite, unchanged support

coordinate.order: all active gauge-reduced constants, all active linear coefficients, all active upper-triangle symmetric precision entries, then active xi; banks ordered side,time,label
coordinate.gauge: first supported constant per incidence is zero
coordinate.inactive: fixed -inf constant support metadata, zero linear/precision; inactive xi exact zero
coordinate.origins: fixed declared reference origins or moderate zero origins; not unknowns
coordinate.corrections: derived high+low covariance, preserve both in cancellation-sensitive differences, not unknowns

initializations.feasible_initializer: one simultaneous quotient sweep from unary cavities at chosen xi; invalid tilt diverges before iteration; inactive xi forced zero
initializations.perturbed: after feasible initializer add 0.01*sin(arange(message_size)+1) to packed message coefficients only, xi unchanged; certify feasibility explicitly

directions: simultaneous quotient and auxiliary-target coordinate update
if all fixed-point trials fail, matrix-free CGLS Gauss-Newton step then identical backtracking
strategy.linear_target: sqrt(eps)*initial_normal_residual_norm; zero or unresolved curvature stops the linear solve without a convergence claim
strategy.linearization: one jax.linearize of the complete signed residual with frozen scales and coordinate scales; jax.linear_transpose of this same JVP; never scalar certificates or optimizer history
strategy.residual_scales: frozen per accepted coordinate: natural and conditional max(1,abs(current),abs(target)), unit label mass, 1+abs(xi); same scales for derivative and every trial
strategy.coordinate_scales: 1+abs(accepted coordinate); linear unknown is step divided by this scale
strategy.merit: sum(square(signed complete residual/frozen residual scales))/2; rectangular M residuals, N unknowns
strategy.xi_boundary: first trial fraction shortened to the nonnegative xi boundary; subsequent halves stay feasible
strategy.internal_target: tau(dtype); stable unchanged re-evaluation permitted only when every other exact certificate passes
strategy.failure: invalid initialization/accepted value -> diverged; no accepted direction, stationary nonzero residual or finite outer budget -> exhausted; invalid trials rejected with counted reason

storage.linear_vectors: CGLS carries step[N], normal_residual[N], direction[N], residual[M]; products use Jp[M], transpose[N]. No restart basis. Accepted/trial coordinate and evaluation coexist. No candidate bank.
storage.history: fixed scalar counters, reason histogram, last rejection code; no retained coordinate/evaluation/optimizer tape
storage.limits: No dense global Jacobian, trajectory covariance, path enumeration, or iteration-history arrays. All derivative captures come only from one accepted local evaluation. Limits are explicit outer/trial/linear caps above.
storage.measurement_interface: shape/dtype/element/byte inventory of layout, context, coordinate, evaluation, frozen scales, derivative closure, linear/outer states; dynamic-argument lower/compile memory_analysis for residual, linearization/normal product, full step/iteration and final certificates; A3WZ owns actual moderate measurements

pre_solve_checks.classification: held-coordinate evaluation/derivative diagnostics only; no candidate checkpoint solve
pre_solve_checks.perturbation: for diagnostic held coordinates only: 0.01*sin(arange(packed_size)+1); xi perturbation kept nonnegative
checks: complete JVP finite difference of frozen-scale residual
transpose inner-product identity reusing the linearized JVP
retained covariance correction contributes to signed difference
pre_solve_checks.finite_difference: eps**(1/3)*(1+norm(x)); one-sided at xi=0; agreement scaled by 64*eps**(1/3) for float64 and 64*sqrt(eps) for float32
pre_solve_checks.dtype: float64 except the explicitly named float32 coupled_t2 held derivative diagnostic. Held arithmetic uses eps of the executed dtype. No float32 solved-coordinate stopping allowance is asserted.

checkpoint_runs.tiny: every inherited case at xi=0 and xi=1; valid cases use both declared message initializations; invalid cases zero messages only
checkpoint_runs.parity: every returned certificate and all output groups; JIT single solves all starts, host solve and vmap compare coupled_t2 zero and one starts

status_variants.expected: exhausted unless complete certificates already pass

checkpoint_runs.attempt_policy: immutable numbered run records; record source/strategy/budget revisions before reruns; retain failed attempts and disclose incomplete measurements
checkpoint_runs.dtype: float64 only; independent propagated stopping allowances apply only to these float64 solved comparisons

moderate_qualification_unchanged.initializations: xi=0 and xi=1, zero messages plus declared feasible initializer, fixed non-oracle message perturbation; candidate budgets frozen separately before execution

applies: Derived component coordinate: local host/JIT and single/vmap packing, evaluation, iteration, certification
Runtime numerical or status invariant: input/trial/accepted/terminal status
boundaries.moderate_solves: A3WZ only; no T32/T100 qualification solves in Y15D
